title: Fix email validation duplicate detection logic - Frontend

requirements.summary: Verify the form submission flow correctly handles both duplicate and unique email submissions, displaying appropriate success or error messages to the user
acceptanceCriteria: When submitting a form with a new email, the success message is displayed and the form resets
When submitting a form with an existing email (case-insensitive match), the error message 'This email is already registered' is displayed
Error states are properly cleared when the user modifies the form and resubmits

file_operations.description: Update the useCreateLead mutation to properly handle the LeadError.duplicateEmail response from the backend. Ensure the mutation correctly interprets the backend's duplicate detection result and propagates appropriate error states to the form component.

Verify and update error handling logic to correctly display 'This email is already registered' when the backend returns a duplicate email error, show success messages for successful submissions, reset the form after success, and clear error states when the user modifies form fields before resubmitting.
